name: qawafel
label: Qawafel
description: B2B marketplace and ZATCA-compliant document platform — sync products, orders, merchants and invoices with Saudi Arabia's leading wholesale network.

host.label: Environment
host.description: Pick the Qawafel environment your API key belongs to.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Your Qawafel API key, from Settings → Developers → API Keys in the Qawafel dashboard.

create_product.label: Create Product
create_product.description: Add a new product to your Qawafel catalog. The workhorse for catalog sync from your ERP or storefront into Qawafel.

type.label: Product Type
type.description: Pick Sale if this is a product you sell. Pick Purchase if it is a product you buy from a supplier (you must also pick the supplier below).

options.label: Purchase (something you buy from a supplier)

sku.label: SKU
sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit — your unique product code. Must be unique within your Qawafel tenant.

name_en.label: Name (English)
name_en.description: Product name in English. Shown on invoices and quotations.

name_ar.label: Name (Arabic)
name_ar.description: Product name in Arabic. Required by Qawafel for ZATCA-compliant invoices.

unit_price.label: Unit Price (SAR)
unit_price.description: Default price per unit in Saudi Riyals as a decimal string with two places, e.g. 99.00.

supplier_id.label: Supplier
supplier_id.description: Required when Product Type is Purchase. Pick the supplier merchant this product is bought from. Leave blank for Sale products.

is_taxable.label: VAT Applies
is_taxable.description: Tick this if 15% VAT applies to this product. Untick for VAT-exempt items.

description_en.label: Description (English)
description_en.description: Optional. Longer description shown on documents.

barcode.label: Barcode
barcode.description: Optional. UPC, EAN or GTIN barcode.

is_active.label: Active
is_active.description: Active products show up in lookups and can be sold. Untick to soft-disable.

external_ref.label: Your Reference ID
external_ref.description: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. your ERP record ID) to link records across systems.

idempotency_key.label: Duplicate Protection Key
idempotency_key.description: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate.

create_product.beforeRequest: const body = request.body; if (body.type === 'purchase' && !body.supplier_id) throw new Error('Supplier is required when Product Type is Purchase'); if (body.type !== 'purchase') delete body.supplier_id; if (body.is_taxable !== false) delete body.is_taxable; if (body.is_active !== false) delete body.is_active; if (!request.headers['Idempotency-Key']) delete request.headers['Idempotency-Key']; return request;

update_product.label: Update Product
update_product.description: Edit a product's price, description, or active state. Only the fields you fill in are updated — leave the rest blank to keep them unchanged.

product_id.label: Product to update
product_id.description: Pick the product you want to change. Only the 100 most recent products are listed.

unit_price.label: New Unit Price (SAR)
unit_price.description: Optional. New price per unit as a decimal string, e.g. 129.00. Leave blank to keep the current price.

description_en.label: New Description (English)
description_en.description: Optional. New English description. Leave blank to keep the current one.

description_ar.label: New Description (Arabic)
description_ar.description: Optional. New Arabic description. Leave blank to keep the current one.

is_active.label: Active
is_active.description: Optional. Tick to keep the product active, untick to soft-disable. Leave blank to keep the current value.

idempotency_key.label: Duplicate Protection Key
idempotency_key.description: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate.

get_product.label: Get Product
get_product.description: Fetch a single product by its Qawafel ID. Returns the full product including price, descriptions, and active status.

product_id.label: Product ID
product_id.description: The Qawafel product ID (starts with prod_).

list_products.label: List Products
list_products.description: Get products from your catalog, with optional filters by type, supplier, SKU, and active status. Returns up to 500 products (5 pages of 100).

type.label: Product Type (filter)
type.description: Optional. Sale returns products you sell. Purchase returns products you buy from suppliers. Leave blank to return both.

sku.label: SKU (filter)
sku.description: Optional. Return only the product with this exact SKU (case-sensitive).

supplier_id.label: Supplier ID (filter)
supplier_id.description: Optional. Only applies when filtering Purchase products. Pass a merchant ID (starts with mer_).

is_active.label: Active only
is_active.description: Tick to return only active products, untick for inactive only. Leave blank to return both.

created_after.label: Created after
created_after.description: Optional. Return only products created after this date and time.

list_products.beforeRequest: const form = (value) => encodeURIComponent(value).replace(/[!'()~]/g, (c) => '%' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()).replace(/%20/g, '+'); const filters = ['type', 'sku', 'supplier_id', 'is_active', 'created_after'].filter((key) => inputs[key]).map((key) => key + '=' + form(inputs[key])).join('&'); const url = '/products' + (filters ? '?' + filters : ''); request.url = url; return request;
list_products.afterResponse: const form = (value) => encodeURIComponent(value).replace(/[!'()~]/g, (c) => '%' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()).replace(/%20/g, '+'); const filters = ['type', 'sku', 'supplier_id', 'is_active', 'created_after'].filter((key) => inputs[key]).map((key) => key + '=' + form(inputs[key])).join('&'); const url = '/products' + (filters ? '?' + filters : ''); const data = response.data.slice(); let cursor = response.pagination && response.pagination.next_cursor; let pages = 1; while (cursor && pages < 5) { const page = call({method: 'GET', url: url, query: {limit: '100', after: cursor}}); data.push(...page.data); cursor = page.pagination && page.pagination.next_cursor; pages += 1; } return {count: data.length, data: data};

create_order.label: Create Completed Order
create_order.description: Sync a completed (fulfilled) order into Qawafel. The order is created directly in Fulfilled state and skips the normal fulfilment workflow.

merchant_id.label: Customer
merchant_id.description: The customer placing the order. Use Create Merchant first if they are new.

line_items.label: Line Items
line_items.description: One row per product: product_id, quantity, unit_price, and optional discount_percentage and external_ref.

postal_code.label: Delivery Address — Postal Code
postal_code.description: Postal code (5 digits in Saudi Arabia).

country.label: Delivery Address — Country
country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. SA for Saudi Arabia.

short_address.label: Saudi Short Address
short_address.description: Optional. The Saudi National Address short code, e.g. RHRA1234.

delivery_option.label: Delivery Method
delivery_option.description: Pick Vendor if you deliver yourself, or Courier to use a delivery service.

delivery_fees.label: Delivery Fees (SAR)
delivery_fees.description: Optional. Delivery fees as a decimal string, e.g. 15.00.

delivery_fees_payer.label: Who Pays Delivery
delivery_fees_payer.description: Required if you set a delivery method.

notes.label: Notes
notes.description: Optional. Internal notes attached to the order.

external_ref.label: Your Reference ID
external_ref.description: Optional. Store an ID from another system here to link records across systems.

idempotency_key.label: Duplicate Protection Key
idempotency_key.description: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate.

create_order.beforeRequest: const body = request.body; if (!body.line_items) body.line_items = []; if (!Object.keys(body.delivery).length) delete body.delivery; if (!request.headers['Idempotency-Key']) delete request.headers['Idempotency-Key']; return request;

update_order_status.label: Update Order Status
update_order_status.description: Move an order forward in the Qawafel fulfilment workflow. Qawafel enforces a strict state machine. To cancel an order, use the Cancel Order action instead.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: The Qawafel order ID (starts with ord_).

transition.label: New Status
transition.description: Pick the next status. Workflow: Pending → Confirmed → Ready for Pickup → Out for Delivery → Delivered → Fulfilled. Qawafel rejects moves that are not valid from the order's current state.

options.label: Confirm — only valid from Pending Vendor Confirmation
Mark Ready for Pickup — only valid from Confirmed
Mark Out for Delivery — only valid from Ready for Pickup
Mark Delivered — only valid from Out for Delivery
Mark Not Delivered — only valid from Out for Delivery
Mark Fulfilled — only valid from Delivered

reason.label: Reason (only used when marking Not Delivered)
reason.description: Required when New Status is Mark Not Delivered — explains why delivery failed (max 500 characters).

idempotency_key.label: Duplicate Protection Key
idempotency_key.description: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate.

update_order_status.beforeRequest: if (inputs.transition === 'not-delivered' && inputs.reason) request.body = { reason: inputs.reason }; if (!request.headers['Idempotency-Key']) delete request.headers['Idempotency-Key']; return request;

cancel_order.label: Cancel Order
cancel_order.description: Cancel an open order. Once cancelled, the order cannot be reopened — the only path forward is to create a new order.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: The Qawafel order ID (starts with ord_) you want to cancel.

reason.label: Cancellation Reason
reason.description: Optional but recommended. A short note explaining why the order is being cancelled (max 500 characters).

idempotency_key.label: Duplicate Protection Key
idempotency_key.description: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate.

get_order.label: Get Order
get_order.description: Fetch a single order by its Qawafel ID. Returns the full order including line items, totals, delivery details, and current state.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: The Qawafel order ID (starts with ord_).

list_orders.label: List Orders
list_orders.description: Get orders, optionally filtered by status, customer, or creation date. Returns up to 500 orders (5 pages of 100).

state.label: Status (filter)
state.description: Optional. Return only orders in this state. Leave blank for all statuses.

merchant_id.label: Customer (filter)
merchant_id.description: Optional. Return only orders from this customer. Leave blank for all customers.

created_after.label: Created After
created_after.description: Optional. Return only orders created after this date and time.

create_merchant.label: Create Merchant (Customer or Supplier)
create_merchant.description: Add a new customer or supplier to your Qawafel tenant. Use this when onboarding a new B2B partner from your CRM, signup form, or another system.

type.label: Merchant Type
type.description: Pick Customer if this party buys from you, or Supplier if you buy from them.

legal_name.label: Legal Name
legal_name.description: The official registered company name as it appears on the commercial registration.

name_en.label: Trade Name (English)
name_en.description: The trade or store name in English. Shown on documents and dashboards.

name_ar.label: Trade Name (Arabic)
name_ar.description: The trade or store name in Arabic. Required by Qawafel for ZATCA-compliant invoices.

email.label: Email
email.description: Primary contact email for this merchant.

phone.label: Phone
phone.description: Primary phone number, including country code (e.g. +966500000000).

unified_national_number.label: Unified National Number
unified_national_number.description: Optional. Saudi Unified National Number, 10 digits starting with 7.

is_taxable.label: VAT Registered
is_taxable.description: Tick if this merchant is registered for VAT.

postal_code.label: Address — Postal Code
postal_code.description: Postal code (5 digits in Saudi Arabia).

country.label: Address — Country
country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. SA for Saudi Arabia.

short_address.label: Saudi Short Address
short_address.description: Optional. National Address short code, e.g. RHRA1234.

external_ref.label: Your Reference ID
external_ref.description: Optional. Store an ID from another system here to link records across systems.

idempotency_key.label: Duplicate Protection Key
idempotency_key.description: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate.

create_merchant.beforeRequest: if (request.body.is_taxable !== false) delete request.body.is_taxable; if (!request.headers['Idempotency-Key']) delete request.headers['Idempotency-Key']; return request;

update_merchant.label: Update Merchant
update_merchant.description: Edit a merchant's trade name or active state. Only the fields you fill in are updated. (Legal name, CR, VAT and other identity fields cannot be changed via the API.)

merchant_id.label: Merchant to update
merchant_id.description: Pick the merchant to update. Use Create Merchant first if they are not yet in Qawafel.

name_en.label: New Trade Name (English)
name_en.description: Optional. Leave blank to keep the current name.

name_ar.label: New Trade Name (Arabic)
name_ar.description: Optional. Leave blank to keep the current name.

is_active.label: Active
is_active.description: Optional. Tick to keep the merchant active, untick to disable. Leave blank to keep the current value.

idempotency_key.label: Duplicate Protection Key
idempotency_key.description: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate.

create_invoice.label: Create Invoice
create_invoice.description: Create an invoice in Qawafel for a customer. The invoice starts in draft state — generate it afterwards to finalize and issue a ZATCA-compliant copy.

issue_date.label: Issue Date
issue_date.description: The date the invoice is issued. Use today for most cases. (YYYY-MM-DD format)

line_items.label: Line Items
line_items.description: One row per product: product_id, quantity, unit_price, vat_percentage, and optional discount_percentage and external_ref.

order_id.label: Linked Order ID
order_id.description: Optional. The Qawafel order ID (ord_…) this invoice is for.

shipping_fees.label: Shipping Fees (SAR)
shipping_fees.description: Optional. Delivery / shipping fees as a decimal string excluding VAT, e.g. 25.00. Defaults to 0.00.

payment_start_date.label: Payment Window Start
payment_start_date.description: Optional. When the payment terms begin. (YYYY-MM-DD format)

payment_due_date.label: Final Payment Due Date
payment_due_date.description: Optional. The absolute final date payment is due. (YYYY-MM-DD format)

notes.label: Notes
notes.description: Optional. Notes printed on the invoice or kept internal.

external_ref.label: Your Reference ID
external_ref.description: Optional. Store an ID from another system here to link records across systems.

idempotency_key.label: Duplicate Protection Key
idempotency_key.description: Advanced. A UUID v4 — if the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate.

create_invoice.beforeRequest: const body = request.body; if (!body.line_items) body.line_items = []; ['issue_date', 'due_date', 'payment_start_date', 'payment_due_date'].forEach((key) => { if (body[key]) body[key] = body[key].slice(0, 10); }); if (!request.headers['Idempotency-Key']) delete request.headers['Idempotency-Key']; return request;

get_invoice.label: Get Invoice
get_invoice.description: Fetch a single invoice by its Qawafel ID. Returns the full invoice including line items, totals, ZATCA PDF URL, and current state.

invoice_id.label: Invoice ID
invoice_id.description: The Qawafel invoice ID (starts with inv_).

list_invoices.label: List Invoices
list_invoices.description: Get invoices, optionally filtered by status, customer, or creation date. Returns up to 500 invoices (5 pages of 100).

state.label: Status (filter)
state.description: Optional. Return only invoices in this state. Leave blank for all statuses.

merchant_id.label: Customer (filter)
merchant_id.description: Optional. Return only invoices for this customer. Leave blank for all customers.

created_after.label: Created After
created_after.description: Optional. Return only invoices created after this date and time.

new_order.label: New Order
new_order.description: Fires the moment a new sales order is created in Qawafel. Use it to fan out to fulfillment, accounting, Slack alerts, or your CRM.

order_status_changed.label: Order Status Changed
order_status_changed.description: Fires when an order moves to a specific status (confirmed, out for delivery, delivered, fulfilled, cancelled, etc.). Pick one status per trigger — add the trigger again for additional statuses.

status.label: Status to listen for
status.description: The flow runs every time an order transitions into the status you pick here.

invoice_paid.label: Invoice Paid
invoice_paid.description: Fires when an invoice is marked as paid in Qawafel. Useful for posting payment receipts to Slack, releasing fulfilment, or syncing revenue to your books.

new_invoice.label: New Invoice Generated
new_invoice.description: Fires when a ZATCA-compliant invoice is finalized in Qawafel (the invoice.generated event). Use it to email PDFs to customers, archive invoices to Drive, or push to your accounting system.

new_product.label: New Product Published
new_product.description: Fires when a new product is created in Qawafel. Use it to mirror your catalog into Shopify, Salla, Zid, or your data warehouse.

product_updated.label: Product Updated
product_updated.description: Fires when a product is updated (price change, description edit, activated/deactivated). Use it to keep external storefronts in sync.

new_merchant.label: New Merchant Registered
new_merchant.description: Fires when a new merchant (customer or supplier) is created in Qawafel. Use it to onboard customers in your CRM or add suppliers to your procurement system.

refund_requested.label: Refund / Credit Note Created
refund_requested.description: Fires when a credit note is created against an invoice (i.e. a customer return or refund is initiated). Use it to alert your finance team or trigger a return workflow.
